description: This file defines a theme configuration for a Flutter application, including color schemes, text styles, and theme extensions for both light and dark modes, specifically tailored for an admin panel UI.

classes.name: SemanticColors
classes.description: A ThemeExtension that exposes semantic colors for success, warning, and danger states within the theme.

methods.name: _baseTextTheme
methods.description: Creates a base TextTheme with styles adjusted for light or dark brightness.

methods.name: _appBarTheme
methods.description: Generates an AppBarTheme configured with appropriate colors and styles based on the provided ColorScheme and Brightness.

methods.name: _cardTheme
methods.description: Creates a CardTheme with styles depending on the brightness mode.

methods.name: _inputTheme
methods.description: Configures InputDecorationTheme with consistent border and padding styles.

methods.name: _elevatedButtonTheme
methods.description: Configures ElevatedButtonThemeData with styles for elevated buttons.

methods.name: _filledButtonTheme
methods.description: Configures FilledButtonThemeData with styles for filled buttons.

methods.name: buildAdminThemeLight
methods.description: Builds and returns a ThemeData instance for Light mode for the admin panel.

methods.name: buildAdminThemeDark
methods.description: Builds and returns a ThemeData instance for Dark mode for the admin panel.

methods.name: buildAdminTheme
methods.description: Returns the default theme, currently set to the Light theme.
